content: Sises Ket Mwohn Pailet
Tohnpokono koaros ahpw kesihnenda oh kahrelahng Sises mwohn Pailet.

Re ahpw tapihada kedipa, ndinda, “Se saikedi ohl menet ni eh wiewia kaweid sapwung ong nait aramas akan, ndindaiong irail re dehr kin kihda daksis ong Sihsar; oh e pil kin kakahski me pein ih Mesaia, nanmwarki men.”
Pailet eri keinemwe rehn Sises, mahsanih, “Komwi nanmwarkien mehn Suhs akan?” Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Komwi me mahsanih.”
Pailet eri mahsanihong samworo lapalap ako oh pokono, “Sohte mehkot I diarada rehn ohl menet pwe en pakadeingkihda.”

A irail ahpw ngidingidkihong, ndinda, “E tapihadahr kamwoarong ehu rehn aramas akan sang ni padahk me e kin kihong irail. E tapihada nan Kalili, kohdo nan sahpw koaros en Sudia, oh lelohngehr sahpwet.”
Sises Ket Mwohn Erod
Ni Pailet eh karonge met, e ahpw keinemwe, “Pwe da, mehn Kalili men ohl menet?”
Ni eh mwahngihada me Sises kisehn wehi ehu me Erod ketin kakaun, e ahpw ketin kadaralahng rehn Erod, me pil iang ketiket Serusalem ni ahnsowo.
Erod inenen perenkihda kowahlap eh mahsanihada Sises, pwe e kin karongehte duwen Sises oh ahnsou reirei e kin anahne en mahsanih, pwe e koapworopworki me Sises pahn ketin wiahda ekei manaman mwowe.
Ih eri ketin wiahiong Sises soangen peidek tohto, a Sises sohte mwahn ketin sapeng.
Samworo lapalap oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko ahpw uh wasao nannantihki ar kedikedipa Sises.
Erod oh sapwellime sounpei ko ahpw kepitki Sises oh wia mwahlkihla. Re kalikawihkihda likou puhp kaselel ehu oh kapwurelahng Pailet.
Rahnohte Pailet oh Erod ira nsenamwahula; pwe sang mahs kohdo ira kin imwintihtipene.
Sises ketin Pakadeikda en Kamakamala
Pailet eri ketin kapokonepene samworo lapalap ako, kaun ako, oh pil aramas koaros,

oh mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail pangodohngieier ohl menet, dene e kamwoakamwoaronge tohn amwail wehi. Eri, kumwail en ese pwe I kalelapakehr reh mwohmwail, ahpw sohte mehkot sapwung I diarada duwen mehkan me kumwail kedikedipahki.
Erod pil sohte diarada sapwung reh, ihme e ketin kapwurehkidohng rehtail ohl menet. Eri, kumwail en ese pwe ohl menet sohte wiahda mehkot me pahn konehng en kamakamkihla.
Iet me I pahn wiahiongen: I pahn kihong en wowoki rehn nei sounpei kan; oh mwuhr I ahpw pahn kasaledekihala.”
[Ni ahnsoun Sarawien Pahsohpa koaros, Pailet uhdahn kin ketin lapwadahng mehn Suhs ako emen loallap suwed me sensel nan imweteng.]
Tohnpokono koaruhsie eri wiahkihteieu ngihl laudida, patohwan, “Mehmenen en kamakamala! Komw ketin lapwadohng kiht Parapas!” (
Eri, Parapas loallap suwed men, me lekdekiong nan imweteng pwehki moromor ehu me wiawi nan kahnimwo oh kamaramas ehu me e wiadahr.)
Pailet kupwukupwurehte en kasaledekala Sises, ihme e pil pwurehngete mahseniong pokono.
A irail wiakihteieu patohwan werkilahng, “Komw kalohpwuwehla! Komw kalohpwuwehla!”
Pailet eri mahsanihong irail kesilipak, “Pwe suwed da me e wiahda? Sohte mehkot I kak diar reh me konehng en kamakamkihla! I pahn kihong en wowoki, mwuhr I ahpw pahn kasaledekihala.”
A irail ahpwte kalaudehla ar weriwerki pwe Sises en kalohpwuwala. Ni imwilah ar pekipeko ahpw pweida.
Pwe Pailet ketin mahsanih sang nan mwoale me Sises en mweimweiong irail, pwe re en kalohpwuwehla.
Ih eri ketin lapwahda ohl me re peki en lapwadahng irailo, me selikihdi moromor oh kamaramas; e ahpw ketikihong irail Sises pwe re en wiahiong nsenarail.
Sises ketin Kalohpwuwala

Irail eri ale Sises oh kahluwaieisang nan kahnimwo; re ahpw kasaingedi ohl emen nanialo, ede Saimon, mehn Sairihni, me patopatohdo sang nan sapwe likin kahnimwo. Re ahpw koledi oh itonehng en kapaikada lohpwuwo oh idawehnla Sises.
Lapalahn pokon en aramas ahpw iang ideidawehn Sises; lih ekei pil iang me mwahmwahieiki oh wie sengisengki Sises.
Sises ketin sohpeiong irail oh mahsanih, “Kumwail, lihen Serusalem kan! Kumwail dehr sengisengkin ie, kumwail sengisengki pein kumwail oh noumwail seri kan.
Pwe rahn ekei pahn kohdo, me aramas akan pahn nda, ‘Meid pai lih depwen kan oh me sohte kin neitik oh kedihdi!’
Pwe ih ahnsowo me aramas pahn ndaiong nahna kan, ‘Kumwail pwupwudiong poht!’ oh ong dohl akan, ‘Kumwail koaduhpwalkitedi!’
Pwe ma ih duwen me soahng pwukat kin wiawihong tuhke mour, a dahme pahn wiawihong tuhke meng?”
Irail eri pil kahreieila loallap suwed riemen, pwe ira en iang Sises kamakamala.
Ni arail lel wasa me adaneki “Tihn Moang,” re ahpw pasurdiong Sises nin lohpwuwo iangahki loallap suwed riemeno, emen mi ni palimaun, a emen palimeing en Sises.
Sises eri mahsanih, “Semei, komw ketin mahkohng irail, pwe re sehse dahme re wiewia.” Irail eri usuhski sapwellime likou ko oh nehkpeseng nanpwungarail.
Pokono ahpw mi wasao uduhdiahl soahng koaros, nindokon kaunen mehn Suhs ko ar kepikepitki Sises, ndinda, “E komourala ekei; eri, a en komourala pein ih, ma iei ih Mesaiao me Koht ketin piladahr!”
Sounpei ko pil iangala kapailoke Sises. Re keiong mpe oh kihong wain
oh ndahng, “Komw kepitkomwihla, ma iei komwi nanmwarkien mehn Suhs akan!”
Pohnangin kadokenmaien Sises nin lohpwuwo mahsen pwukat ntingdier ie: “Iei met Nanmwarkien mehn Suhs akan.”
Emen loallap suwed ko me iang kalohpwuwala ahpw lahlahwe Sises, ndinda, “Ma komwi Mesaiao, a komw kepitkomwihla oh pil kiht!”
A meteio ahpw kapwungohng, nda, “Ke sohte masak Koht? Kita koaros mihmi nan soangen kadeikteieu.
Ahpw ata kadeik me pwung, pwe kita konehng ale kalokolok wet, pwehki ata wiewia kan me kahrehda; a ohl menet sohte suwed ehu e ketin wiahda.”
Ih eri patohwanohng Sises, “Maing Sises, komw ketin kupwure ie, ni omwi pahn ket nan sapwellimomwi wehi duwen nanmwarki men!”
A Sises ketin mahsanihong, “I men ke en ese pwe rahnwette ke pahn iang ie mi nan Paradais.”
Sises Pwoula
Kolahng nin souwas limwahn kulok eisek riau, ketipin ahpw rotala oh rotorot kipehdi wasa koaros nan sahpwo lel kulok siluh mwurin souwas.
Oh kahdeng me pereh mwoahl sarawien nan Tehnpas Sarawio teipeseng nanwerenge sang powe lel pah.
Sises ahpw ketin kapitie laudida, mahsanih, “Semei, I mweidalahr ngeniet nin limomwi kan!” Ni eh mahsanih met, e ahpw ketin kadarala ngene.
Kaunen sounpei men lao kilangada me wiawiero, e ahpw kapinga Koht, patopatohwan, “Mehlelete me ohl menet ohl pwung men!”
Aramas koaros me pokonpene wasao pwe re en iang udiahl, re ahpw pikipikir nan mwaremwararail kan pwurala ni imwarail ko, uwen ar nsensuwed.
Oh kompoakepahn Sises koaros, iangahki lih ako me idawehndo sang Kalili, re pil iang kesihnen wasao, ahpw ekis dohsang, uduhdiahl mepwukat koaros.
Sises ketin Nekinekdi

Ohl emen mie me mwarenki Sosep, mehn Arimadea, kahnimw ehu nan Suda. Ohl kadek emen oh poadidi, oh e kin iang awiawihodo Wehin Koht. E kin iang towe Mwoalen Kopwung Lapalap, ahpw e sohte mwahn iang pwungki arail koasoandi oh arail mwekid kan ong Sises.
Ih eri patohla rehn Pailet oh pekihda ereksohn Siseso.
Ih eri kihdi sang nin lohpwuwo, kidimkipene likou linen ehu, oh kihlong nan sousou ehu me weiweida nan paip ehu—saikinte aramas emen seridi nan sousowo.
Rahno ni alem, oh rahnen Sapad, de ahnsoun Sapad, nektehn tepida.
Lih ako me ideidawehndo Sises sang Kalili ahpw idawehnla Sosep oh iang udiahl sousowo oh duwen ereksohn Sises eh nekinekdi loale.
Irail eri pwurala ni imwarail ko oh onopada pwohtik pwohmwahu kei oh mehn kei kei. Rahnen Sapad, re ahpw kommoal, duwen me kileldier nan Kosonnedo.
